title: A ripple on touch
description: A soft circle expands from the exact point where the button is pressed.
useCase: Provide visible confirmation on an occasional touch-friendly action.
interaction: Click at different points on the button
reducedMotion: The click updates its text feedback without the expanding ripple.
limitations: The action only increments a local preview count. Ripples are bounded to eight and remove themselves when their animation ends.
look: Warm beige page with a single centred caramel-brown rounded button with a darker border and dark sans-serif label.
motion: Each click spawns a pale circle at the pointer that scales from 0 to 2× while fading out over 650 ms ease-out; keyboard activation and reduced motion skip the ripple.
adapt: `handleClick` sizes and positions each `Ripple` from the click point (keeping the last eight) and `onAnimationEnd` removes it; the `mg-button-ripple` keyframe sets scale and fade over 650ms. Replace the label, colours and the `count` demo action.
